This '''mimph''' was a member of the hunting party that captured<ref name="gone">{{Ewoks|Gone With the Mimphs}}</ref> the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]]<ref name="wicket-db">{{DB|character|wicketwwarrick|Warrick, Wicket W.}}</ref> [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]]<ref name="gone" /> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="date">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=1905#14621041|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2006-04-20|time=11:42 AM}}</ref> The team, consisting of this [[mimph]], as well as the mimphs [[Smasher]], [[Thrasher (mimph)|Trasher]], and the team's [[Unidentified mimph hunting team leader|leader]], tied Warrick to a wheeled vehicle and dragged him back to their [[Mimph village|village]].<ref name="gone" />
